name: EVM Guard MCP Suite (AegisGate + GasPulse + AuditPulse)
description: Zero-dependency EVM agent safety suite: real-time OFAC/mixer AML screening (AegisGate), multi-chain RPC failover and pre-flight tx simulation (GasPulse), and continuous smart-contract/pool invariant monitoring (AuditPulse). Supports local stdio MCP and single-URL remote HTTP MCP (POST /mcp).

tools.name: screen_evm_address
tools.description: Screen an EVM address for OFAC/mixer risk, contract bytecode, and EIP-1967 proxy status.

tools.name: estimate_gas
tools.description: Estimate EIP-1559 gas tiers and congestion across Base, Ethereum, and Arbitrum.

tools.name: simulate_transaction
tools.description: Pre-flight eth_call and eth_estimateGas simulation with Solidity revert decoding, balance checks, and AML screening.

tools.name: check_rpc_health
tools.description: Probe multi-chain RPC latency, block lag, and circuit-breaker health.

tools.name: inspect_contract_invariants
tools.description: Inspect proxy/admin slots, opcode risk signals, ERC-20 supply/decimals, and DEX/vault reserve invariants.

tools.name: diff_contract_snapshots
tools.description: Diff two AuditPulse inspection snapshots and format generic, Slack, or Discord risk alerts.

tools.name: verify_x402_payment
tools.description: Verify a Base Mainnet USDC x402 transaction receipt against the receive-only treasury.
